lines.meet: Enzo, and I'm the best swordsman you'll ever meet. Watch my feet, not the blade, and stay out of my distance.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Monastery grounds, yes? We've watched the same drills from the same wall. Enzo, and I'm the one who's always scoring them.
lines.ask_home: Which city made you? Everybody's made by a city, whether they like it or not.
lines.ask_work: Before all this, what were you good at? Properly good, I mean, not just paid for.
lines.answer_home: Naples, the Spanish Quarter, where the streets are so narrow you can pass an espresso from one balcony to the other.
lines.answer_work: I fenced sabre from the age of eight. Fourth at the Olympic trials, twice, and fourth is the worst place there is.
lines.chat_food: My mother's ragù, cooking from seven in the morning on a Sunday. The whole stairwell smelled of it, and the neighbours came up with bread.
lines.chat_sleep: Before a bout I never slept, not once in twenty years. Here every day is a bout, so you can imagine.
lines.chat_missing: My scooter, mannaggia, a red Vespa older than me. I rode it through the Quarter at a speed my mother didn't want to know about.
lines.chat_here: A voice in the dark offered me more, and I took it. Now I'm the best I've ever been, and I'm still deciding what that cost.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're quiet like a good fencer before the call. I'm waiting for the lunge, and it never comes.
lines.tease_talker: You talk the way beginners fence, {name}, everything at once and no recovery. It's charming, though.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd stand en garde for an hour waiting for the perfect opening. Sometimes you make the opening.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you attack like a twelve-year-old with a new sabre. I mean that kindly, I was one.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you've got terrible footwork and a good heart. I can fix one of those.
lines.tease_back: Touché, {name}, and a clean one. I'll give you the point.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fair, {name}, I'll concede that one. My mother would agree with you, loudly.
lines.bristle: Careful with that, {name}. You're inside my distance now.
lines.apologise: That was a cheap touch, and I'm sorry. I don't like to win that way.
lines.double_down: I'll stand behind that one, completely. You heard me the first time.
lines.needle_quiet: You never call your attack, so nobody can cover you. Say something before you move.
lines.needle_talker: You never stop talking, and it's a tell. Everything we're fighting can hear exactly where you are.
lines.needle_careful: You're so careful you never commit, and a fencer who won't commit is just standing in a white suit.
lines.needle_bold: You charge without a plan and call it courage. I've seen what happens to fencers like that.
lines.needle_any: You look at the blade instead of the feet, every single time. I've stopped expecting better.
lines.bite_back: I came fourth at the Olympic trials, twice, and I've been told worse by better. Try a sharper blade.
lines.hurt: Mannaggia, that one landed clean. I'll go and practise alone for a while.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, my mother shouted worse at referees every Saturday for twenty years. Jamme, let's go.
lines.confide: {name}, the voice in my arm makes me the best I've ever been. I'll never know if it's really me holding the sword, and that's the worst part.
lines.listen: I won't say anything, {name}, I promise you that. Thank you for trusting me with it.
lines.look_out: {name}, keep inside my reach in there. Nothing gets past my blade, and I'd like you where I can see you.
lines.accept: Jamme, {name}, your way. I'll follow your lead this once.
lines.deflect: Please, {name}, it's a scratch. I've had worse from a training blade.
lines.check_in: {name}, where did it touch you? Show me, I've seen a thousand wounds on the piste.
lines.blame: Somebody lunged without looking, and the rest of us paid. I know who it was.
lines.thank: You pulled me back from the edge of the piste, so to speak. Grazie, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: Prego, it's nothing. Breathe and get your feet under you.
lines.worry: {name}, mannaggia, you frightened me. Stand still and let me see where it went in.
lines.handed_down: Your gear, I think, and now it's on me. I'll keep it sharp for you.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, I don't mind at all. A good fencer only needs the sword.
lines.hand_sulk: So it's gone, and nobody thought to ask. I'll remember that.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I'd fence beside you any day. That's real respect, from me.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd let you stand as my second. That's the highest honour I know how to give.
lines.turn_grating: We're not a good match, you and I. Let's keep our distance and be civil.
lines.turn_rivals: Stay out of my distance and I'll stay out of yours. That's the only rule between us now.
lines.make_up: {name}, enough, let's salute and start the bout again. I was being proud, as usual.
lines.defend: No, that's not fair at all. {name} kept their line the whole way, I watched.
lines.friend_left: It's like fencing without a partner with {name} away. I hate it.
lines.friend_back: There you are, {name}! En garde, we've got work to do.
lines.common_sport: I fenced for twenty-two years and coached the little ones on Saturdays. Anyone who's played something seriously stands the way you do.
lines.common_italian: You speak Italian! Finally, somebody who knows how to talk with their hands properly.
